purpose: Mobile-app landing hero: tag, headline with a coloured emphasis span, bold-led pitch and two CTAs (talk to sales, or open a QR install dialog), beside a square photo with a looping stack of sample notification cards that demonstrates what the app surfaces.

headline.note: h1, uppercase heading font, extrabold, balanced. The second sentence is wrapped in a pink-11 coloured span. Observed 12 words.

body.note: A bold lead sentence followed by a plain sentence. Observed about 34 words.

ctas.note: First is a primary link (talk to sales); second is an outline button that opens the download dialog and has no href.

image.note: Square photo of a conference scene, rounded, with empty alt (decorative here).

notifications.note: Sample cards cycled in the overlay stack. Each pairs a lucide icon with a tinted chip (bg-*-2 / text-*-13). The content is illustrative copy, not real customer data.

downloadDialog.note: Dialog opened by the second CTA: QR code, a fallback line and two store badges linking to the app stores.

behaviour.note: Page-local component; the file lives under components/blog/ but is used only by the /apps/mobile page.

Download dialog: the shared CardDialog (dialog.jsx) with a 440px-max panel, close button, Escape and overlay-click to close, body scroll locked while open (useModal). Opens and closes with no animation (the original Radix dialog also opens without animation).

The notification stack is aria-hidden and pointer-events-none: decorative only, anchored at the bottom of the photo, max 400px wide. Once three cards are visible the oldest exits as a new one arrives.

motion.reducedMotionNote: Proposal only: no prefers-reduced-motion handling exists. A new card arrives every 2600ms; at most 3 are visible (opacity by rank 1 / .7 / .45, 250ms easeOut). Entering card slides translateY(28px) scale(.96) to none over 400ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); existing cards FLIP-shift with the same 400ms; the oldest exits scale .95 and fades over 180ms cubic-bezier(0,0,.58,1). The timer runs continuously with no in-view gating.

changes.change: single column: text first, photo below; grid gap 40px
text column 5 cols (md), 9 (lg), 8 from col 2 (xl); photo 7 cols from col 6 at md, 14 from col 11 at lg and xl
the two CTAs sit in two columns (max 400px wide); below sm they stack
notification body text is clamped to one line and the card is slightly smaller (icon chip 28px, padding 12px); the stack sits 12px from the photo edge (20px from md)
